OOD: reject until separately frozen realized parameter dictionaries; no default draws

ancestry.BAA: omit unused terminal population/event only; preserve all retained graph sizes/events/dates

coordinates.selection_note: explicit new root-selected supported chr22 arm; actual receipt required, no built-in interval fallback

error.draw_order: every simulated mutation site increasing rebased position; every haplotype in frozen roster order, including sites later filtered
error.filter: drop posterror invariant sites, retain observed binary segregating sites
error.rule: draw<0.001 flips 0/1 allele; draw==0.001 does not flip

method_condition: prospective synthetic1611; no exact original-paper reproduction
sample_identity: allocate names against actual individuals/population/date; phase is actual per-individual ts.samples order, recorded once; no node arithmetic
truth: separate private simulation.trees with exact census350 + simulation ID/population maps; only later inferred-tree midpoint targets may be labeled
